# Track Studio 1.2.9

Track Studio now opens audio files from iCloud Drive on macOS. Mixtape can layer up to four songs and generate editable chapter timestamps. The release also adds a library health check, makes settings searchable, and fixes flicker and stutter when dragging the larger deck waveforms.

## New Features

- **iCloud Drive (macOS only)** lets you browse folders and audition audio from the sidebar in Browse mode. Cloud-only files download on demand when played or copied. Copy tracks between iCloud Drive and your local library, or remove a local download to free disk space while keeping the file in iCloud Drive.
- **Mixtape** lets you switch between two and four timeline lanes and layer up to four songs at once. Use **Chapters** to generate timestamps from when each track first becomes audible, then edit the text before copying it.
- Open **Collection health** from a library’s context menu to find low-bitrate tracks, missing artwork, inconsistent album tags, and possible duplicate audio. Jump straight to a track in its playlist to review it.
- **Settings** now has category navigation and search by name, description, or alias. Select a result to jump to the setting, or use the Common page to revisit the five most recently changed settings.
- **Key detection** offers a choice between fast template matching and a neural network. A badge beside the BPM marks beat grids that may need review.

## Fixes and Improvements

- Fixed flicker and stutter when dragging the large waveforms in dual-deck Browse mode.
- Improved dynamic beat-grid fitting, including for tracks with sparse beats in their intros and outros.
- NetEase Cloud Music can delete playlists you created or unfollow saved playlists. You can keep downloaded files or move downloads exclusive to the affected playlist to the recycle bin. Sync skips playlists it cannot read and reports them when it finishes.
- Example tracks ship with analysis data. The Windows installer omits unused FFmpeg libraries, and the release build checks the packaged binaries on both Windows and macOS.

**Upgrading on macOS.** Use the in-app update from 1.2.8. If you’re on 1.2.7 or earlier, quit Track Studio and replace it once in Applications using the installer.

# Track Studio 1.2.9 中文更新说明

macOS 现在可以在 Track Studio 里直接打开 iCloud Drive 中的音频。Mixtape 最多可同时叠放四首歌，并生成可编辑的章节时间戳。本版还新增了曲库体检和设置搜索，修复了拖动双轨大波形时的闪烁与卡顿。

## 新功能

- **iCloud Drive（仅 macOS）**可从侧边栏打开，在浏览模式下浏览文件夹和试听曲目。仅存于云端的曲目会在播放或复制时按需下载。支持在 iCloud Drive 与本地曲库之间复制曲目，也可移除本机下载来释放空间，文件仍保存在 iCloud Drive 中。
- **Mixtape** 支持在 2 轨和 4 轨之间切换，最多同时叠放四首歌。时间线菜单里的「章节」会按每首歌实际开始出声的时间生成时间戳，文本可以编辑后复制。
- 在库的右键菜单打开**曲库体检**，可检查低码率、缺失封面、专辑标签不一致和疑似重复音频，并从结果直接定位到原歌单中的曲目。
- **设置**新增分类导航，可按名称、说明或别名搜索并跳转到对应设置。「常用」页还能回到最近修改的 5 项设置。
- **调性检测**可选择速度较快的模板匹配或神经网络。节拍网格需要复核时，BPM 旁会显示徽标。

## 修复与改进

- 修复双轨浏览模式下拖动大波形时的闪烁和卡顿。
- 改善动态节拍网格拟合，包括前奏或尾奏拍点稀疏的曲目。
- 网易云支持删除自建歌单和取消收藏歌单，可保留下载，也可将仅属于所操作歌单的下载移入回收站。同步时会跳过无法读取的歌单，并在完成后提示。
- 安装包内的示例曲目自带分析数据。Windows 安装包移除了未使用的 FFmpeg 库，发布构建会检查 Windows 和 macOS 安装包中的二进制文件。

**macOS 升级方式。** 从 1.2.8 可直接在应用内更新。从 1.2.7 或更早版本升级时，请先退出 Track Studio，再使用安装包替换「应用程序」中的旧版。

[Full Changelog / 完整改动](https://github.com/coderDJing/Track-Studio/compare/1.2.8...1.2.9)
